name: Vilaür (Spain)
description: Three horizontal stripes of green, yellow and green in the proportions 2:1:1, with three yellow ovals set two and one in the upper hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 1 April 1996 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 2199 of 26 April 1996; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided into three horizontal stripes of relative proportions 2, 1, 1, green, yellow and green, with three ovals of major diameter 1/4 of the height in the canton.

features.role: three ovals set two and one in the canton, 1/4 of the height
